newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Soros, Morgan Stanley among Svyazinvest winners. [CORRECTED 17:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Soros, Morgan Stanley among Svyazinvest winners. [CORRECTED 17:00 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects throughout to make clear Morgan Stanley Asset Management involved in deal, instead of just "Morgan Stanley" as sent, following clarification).

The winners of Russia's biggest ever privatisation deal, the sale of a quarter of telecoms holding company Svyazinvest, include billionaire financier George Soros and U.S. asset management group Morgan Stanley Asset Management, a Russian bank in the winning consortium said on Monday.

MUSTCOM Ltd, which won an auction last week for one quarter Svyazinvest was set up by Russia's third biggest bank Uneximbank and Germany's Deutsche Bank, Bank MFK (ICFI), the investment bank affiliate of Uneximbank, said in a statement.

MUSTCOM represents ICFI Cyprus, part of the Unexim-ICFI group, Renaissance International, part of Moscow investment bank Renaissance Capital, Deutsche's investment banking division Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Morgan Stanley Asset Management and the Quantum group, representing Soros's interests, it said.
The controlling stake in MUSTCOM belongs to Russian banks and companies, led by Uneximbank, the statement said.

The winner offered $1.875 billion for 25 percent plus one share in Svyazinvest, which has controlling stakes in 88 regional telecoms and long-distance carrier Rostelekom --Moscow Newsroom, +7095 941 8520
